column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 4 Begird, Cherubim and Marco introduction
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: Honestly, I was worried! When I got back after running into them, you were suddenly in that state!!
I really thought it was all over!!
Yeah, sorry about that.
From now on, I'll try not to stray too far from everyone.
Oh, shut it! Those enemies were nothing!
(Damn that smug bastard. He took all the best parts for himself!)
But who are those people beside $$ガイさん$$?
Hmm. They appear to be white $$羽$$ people, but...
Ooooh! That is exactly what we have sought for years:
the armor of $$大邪神$$ $$メタトロン$$!!
You must be the $$救世主$$ we have been waiting for!
At any rate, I thank you, but who exactly are you people...?
Ah! Forgive my failure to introduce myself!
I am $$ケルビム$$, serving as the strategist of a certain organization!
Now, Lord $$マルコ$$, please introduce yourself to the $$救世主$$'s party!
Pleased to meet you! I am $$マルコ$$, leader of this organization!
W-what did you say!?
Could you be the one said to be the first in this $$世界$$ to release the $$大邪神$$ armor—
that miracle boy $$マルコ$$!?
Before we discuss the details, we must tend to the woman there!
Please, come to our headquarters for now!!
This is $$ベギルド$$, the City of $$欲情$$, where our headquarters is located.
This city especially practices $$欲情$$, one of the $$アンゲルス教団$$'s $$七つの美徳$$, so...
the $$教団$$ pays it little attention.
Many of the $$奴隷$$s used here secretly belong to the underground organization.
I see.
Still, for a city that practices $$欲情$$, it really is quite a sensual place.
Movie: "Introducing $$ベギルド$$"
